## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1 (continued — runner.py is downstream of cycle_ledger keying): cycle_number derivation must respect the new (pr_number, sha) key shape.
- Considerations [Correctness]: "The cycle-number derivation in runner.py:165-168 (`cycles[-1]['cycle_num'] + 1`) MUST be updated to scope to the current (pr_number, sha) tuple, not bare sha."

## Implementation Notes

Create/extend `tests/scripts/test_runner_cycle_derivation_scoping.py` (Python test, since runner.py is Python and existing runner-related tests live under tests/scripts/) — or extend an existing test if one covers `runner.py:165-168` cycle derivation.

**Test approach (Given / When / Then)**:
- Given: a ledger with cycles entries `[{pr_number: 42, commit_sha: "abc123", cycle_num: 1}, {pr_number: 99, commit_sha: "abc123", cycle_num: 1}, {pr_number: 99, commit_sha: "abc123", cycle_num: 2}]` (two PRs sharing the same SHA; PR 99 already on cycle 2; PR 42 on cycle 1)
- When: runner derives cycle_number for context `pr_number=42, commit_sha=abc123`
- Then: returned cycle_number == 2 (PR 42's next cycle), NOT 3 (which is what the bare-sha derivation would yield by reading the last entry regardless of PR)
- And: derives cycle_number for `pr_number=99, commit_sha=abc123` returns 3 (PR 99's next cycle, correctly scoped)
- And: derives cycle_number for a new `pr_number=7, commit_sha=abc123` returns 1 (no prior cycles for PR 7 on this SHA; sentinel-pr=0 entries WOULD match if present, but in this fixture none are)

Test fails RED on current `runner.py:165-168` which does `cycles[-1]['cycle_num'] + 1` without pr_number filtering.

Update `.test-index` with RED marker `[test_runner_cycle_derivation_scoped_by_pr]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `tests/scripts/test_runner_cycle_derivation_scoping.py` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker only) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] tests/scripts/test_runner_cycle_derivation_scoping.py exists
  Verify: test -f tests/scripts/test_runner_cycle_derivation_scoping.py
- [ ] Test is initially RED (runner.py:165-168 not yet scoped)
  Verify: ! pytest tests/scripts/test_runner_cycle_derivation_scoping.py 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q '0 failed'
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_runner_cycle_derivation_scoped_by_pr\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet\xe2\x86\x92opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
